description: This bar chart, titled “The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful Communication Datasets,” illustrates the number of datasets for different languages over a period from 2012 to 2022, with the vertical axis labeled “Number of datasets” using a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^1 to 10^2, and the horizontal axis labeled “Year,” displaying years in chronological order from 2012 to 2022. The legend, labeled “Languages,” indicates that blue bars represent “1” language, while orange bars represent “2” languages, though the legend’s gray square does not correspond to any visible bar. The chart shows that for each year, there is typically one blue bar and one orange bar, except for 2022, which features a single light blue bar and no orange bar. The blue bars generally increase in height over time, starting at approximately 1 in 2012, reaching around 10 in 2016, rising to about 30 in 2017, approximately 50 in 2018, around 70 in 2019, about 100 in 2020, peaking at approximately 120 in 2021, and then decreasing to about 50 in 2022. The orange bars are consistently shorter than the blue bars, starting at approximately 1 in 2012, increasing to about 3 in 2017, around 5 in 2018, approximately 10 in 2019, about 20 in 2020, around 25 in 2021, and then dropping to approximately 1 in 2022. The bars are not sorted by value, and no bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their color and height.
